About Me

Behind the screen

I am Aminah, a freelance web developer and digital visibility specialist who believes a great website is the beginning of your online story, not the end of it. I do not just build sites. I build platforms that get discovered, trusted and acted upon.

My work sits at the crossroads of clean design and strategic visibility. Whether you need a brand new website, want your existing site transformed, or need your business showing up where your customers are searching today, including AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, I make that happen.

My clients are business owners, founders and entrepreneurs who understand that online presence today is about more than just having a website. It is about being found by the right people, in the right places, at the right time.

✓

Every site I build is judged on how it looks and how it converts, not one or the other.

Traditional SEO is not enough anymore. I structure content so AI answer engines can find and cite you.

What I Do

My Services

From concept to launch and beyond. I deliver web experiences that look incredible and perform on both traditional search and AI powered discovery.

Core Service

Website Design

Custom websites built from scratch, tailored to your brand and business goals. Every detail is intentional, every pixel purposeful. Designs that make people stop and take action.

Popular

Website Revamp

Already have a site that feels outdated? I transform it completely. Better design, faster load times, cleaner code and results your competitors will notice.

Content

Website Content

Words that sell and rank. I write compelling, structured content for your pages that speaks to your audience and satisfies both search engines and AI answer platforms.

New Era

AEO / GEO Service & Management

Answer Engine Optimization and Generative Engine Optimization. I make sure your business is cited by ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Claude. This is the future of search and I deliver it today.

Conversion

Landing Pages

High converting, focused landing pages designed to capture leads, drive sales and create powerful first impressions for your campaigns and product launches.

Maintenance

Bug Fixing & Speed

Website broken, glitchy or slow? I diagnose and fix issues fast. Layout breaks, JavaScript errors, broken checkouts, poor Core Web Vitals scores. Fast sites rank better and convert more.
